title: Full-Value Portion for Claimants Who Elected Earlier Pass-Through Allocations — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Estate Terms
content:
# Full-Value Portion for Claimants Who Elected Earlier Pass-Through Allocations

**Estate terms — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** A claimant who already elected the estate's earlier pass-through allocations keeps part of the later pass-through row at full value:

- where the account carries at least **10** pass-through estate retirement entries, **25 percent (0.25)** of the gross is paid at full value;
- where it carries at least one and fewer than 10, **10 percent (0.1)** of the gross is paid at full value;
- where it carries none, no part is paid at full value.

The discount acts only on the rest of the gross; the payable of the elected row consists of the full-value part together with the discounted rest.

**Pass-through estate retirement entries** are the special retirement entries of the estate type on the deceased member's capital account whose source is the wholesale-supplier pass-through allocation, counted at the time of the election.

## Entries and full-value part

| Pass-through estate retirement entries on the account | Part of the gross at full value |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 to 9 | 10 percent |
| 10 or more | 25 percent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical discount leaving 0.50 of value)

| Entries on the account | Gross | Full-value part | Discounted rest | Payable |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | $800.00 | $200.00 | $600.00 discounted to $300.00 | $500.00 |
| 9 | $800.00 | $80.00 | $720.00 discounted to $360.00 | $440.00 |
| 0 | $800.00 | none | $800.00 discounted to $400.00 | $400.00 |
